How It Works

Four steps, start to finish.

1

Pick your build

Choose a build or a package and tell us about your project.

2

Pay in LUNC

One clear fee, confirmed with you before any work starts. All prices are in USD — you pay in LUNC, and the amount is worked out at the live rate when you pay, so the price never crashes with the token.

3

We build & auto-deploy

The studio builds from proven templates, tests it, and deploys it.

4

It's yours

Everything lands in your wallet — you own it from block one.

The studio never holds your keys or your supply — no custody, ever.

Token Factory details

This is a demo — ordering opens at launch.

Featured Build

A premium game the studio built for OrbitWire — live and playable right now.

🛡️ ORBIT DEFENDER — HOW IT WORKS ▾TAP TO OPEN

You fly a starfighter defending the pool. Your finger steers the ship, crystal cannons fire, and you can dash or hold to charge a plasma shot. Waves of token ships and fighter planes come at you, and every level ends with a big Vault ship you have to crack. There are 10 levels, each harder than the last — finish all 10 and Endless mode opens up. It runs right in the browser, phone or computer, nothing to install.

The fighters

  • 4 fighters, unlocked by how far you fly
  • 6 NFT fighters you can buy inside the game with LUNC. The NFT mints straight to your own wallet, and owning it unlocks that fighter with real advantages — faster, tougher, stronger guns. The game reads ownership from the blockchain, so your fighters are really yours.

Continue

Lose your ship and you get one Continue per run — 10,000 LUNC puts you right back where you went down, score intact.

The boards

Two leaderboards: one for players without NFTs, one for NFT players. Your name, your best score and your rank show on the title screen and when your run ends. The title screen also keeps a running count of LUNC burned by the game wallet.

▶ PLAY ORBIT DEFENDER

🛡️ WHY OWNERS ARE SAFE HERE

You don't have to trust us. The design means you don't need to.

🔑 NEVER A SEED

We will never ask for your seed phrase or private key — not in a form, not in a chat, not ever. Anyone who asks is not us.

🏦 NO CUSTODY, EVER

The studio never holds your tokens, your supply, or your keys. There is nothing here for us to run off with — the design makes it impossible, not just unlikely.

👑 YOU ARE THE OWNER FROM BLOCK ONE

Every build is deployed to YOUR wallet. You are owner, admin and minter. We get no admin keys to your project.

✅ PROVEN CODE ONLY

Builds run on contract code already live on-chain with a track record — not fresh untested code with your name on it.

🔍 EVERYTHING VERIFIABLE

Every delivery comes with full addresses as clickable explorer links, and every paid order gets a numbered receipt with transaction proof. Check anything yourself, in one tap.

🛡️ SECURITY IS OUR DAY JOB

The same studio runs live security monitoring on Luna Classic — contract watches, admin-move alerts, a security bot the Garuda DeFi team relies on. Safety isn't a feature we added; it's the work we already do.

⚠️ THE USUAL STORY OUT THERE

A stranger DMs you, offers to build cheap, asks for a seed "to set it up," takes payment to a fresh wallet, keeps the admin keys — or just vanishes. Project owners get drained by the people they hired. This studio exists so you never have to trust a stranger: the process above is how you verify everything yourself.

📜 TERMS & CONDITIONS

1. Who we are.

LUNC Dev Studio builds blockchain software on Luna Classic (Terra Classic, columbus-5): tokens, NFT collections and mint shops, games, staking and rewards apps, assistant bots, websites, leaderboards, and setup services. Everything is built from code that is already proven live on-chain.

2. What you own.

Everything we deliver for your project is yours. Your token, collection, contracts, and apps are created with YOU as owner and admin from the first block. We never hold your keys, your seed phrase, or your funds, and we will never ask for them. Anyone who asks for your seed phrase is a scammer — including anyone claiming to be us.

3. Prices and payment.

Prices are set in US dollars and paid in LUNC, converted at the live market rate at the moment of payment. The amount of LUNC is confirmed with you before you pay. When we verify your payment on-chain, you receive a numbered receipt with the transaction proof. Prices on this page can change for future orders; the price on your confirmed order never changes.

4. What a price includes.

Each item's card says, in plain words, what you get and what is not included. If it is not written on the card, it is not included. Add-ons (art, copy, domains, bookkeeping, and the rest) are separate unless your package lists them.

5. Delivery.

Token creation is automatic once your payment is verified. Other builds are prepared by our team and reviewed by you before they go live; the order page and our messages tell you the step your build is on. Steps that can only be done from your own accounts (for example creating a Telegram bot in BotFather, or publishing to an app store under your developer account) stay yours — we prepare everything and guide you through that one step.

6. If we cannot deliver.

If we cannot deliver what your confirmed order says, you receive a full refund of the studio fee for that order, in LUNC, to the wallet that paid. Registrar fees, app-store developer fees, and other third-party charges are paid by you directly to those providers and are refunded under their rules, not ours.

7. What we never promise.

We do not guarantee profits, returns, prices, trading volume, exchange or DEX listings, app-store approval, or that any token or NFT will sell. Store approvals are the stores' decision. Listings are the exchanges' and aggregators' decision. A build being technically live is what we deliver; what the market does with it is not ours to promise.

8. Trading tools.

The Trading Bot Pack is under development and is not sold until small-number testing is complete. No trading product from us will ever promise profits.

9. Bookkeeping add-on.

The Accountant Project Summary keeps records of your project’s payments from its game/project wallet: dated entries, LUNC amounts, USD values at the live rate at the moment of each transaction, and yearly totals. It is bookkeeping, not tax advice, and not tax filing. You (or your own accountant) still file your taxes. Payments made outside the normal payment flow are recorded as “other — unclassified”; explaining them is your responsibility. LUNC Dev Studio is not an accounting firm.

10. Domains add-on (Auto Domain).

With Project Domains, we register your project's domain for you, connect it to your site, and verify it live — the first year's registration for a standard name is included in the add-on price. The domain is then moved into YOUR OWN registrar account, so you own it outright. Renewals after the first year are yours (about $11/yr for a .com). If the name you want is a premium-priced name, we quote its price before registering anything — premium prices are not included.

11. Support.

Support exists in exactly one place: the chat on this website, using your reference code. We do not offer support through Telegram, X, or any messenger, and nobody from the studio will message you first offering help. Anyone doing that is a scammer.

Studio email — for the written record only: luncdevstudios@gmail.com. Help itself is answered only in the chat on this website.

12. Acceptable projects.

We do not build anonymous projects, gambling mechanics, or anything designed to mislead buyers. We may decline or refund an order that crosses these lines.

13. Scope.

Version 1 of the studio works on Luna Classic only. Creations that need new contract code uploaded to the chain require a governance proposal under current chain rules; the order card says so when it applies.

14. Changes.

These terms can be updated; the version on this page at the moment you pay is the version that applies to your order.

Last updated: October 30, 2026.

  • Luna Classic only for now — other chains are a later phase.
  • No custody, ever: your assets are created in, and stay in, your own wallet.
  • No guaranteed returns, listings or store approvals — those are other parties' decisions, and anyone who promises them is lying to you.
  • This page is a preview — the studio is not taking orders yet.
  • All prices are in USD — you pay in LUNC, and the amount is worked out at the live rate when you pay, so the price never crashes with the token.
